Given this explanation, we see that a highly energetic string is not constrained to be tiny, since it no longer has any direct connection to the graviton particle (the graviton is a [ow-energy, zero-mass vibrational pat tern). In fact, as more and more energy is pumped into a string, at first it will vibrate more and more frantically.
